matched_biomarkers.biomarker: other: CA IX / CA XII expression

note: EARLY_PHASE1, so this is the translational subset. Both coders code CA IX/XII as a matched eligibility biomarker for [177Lu]Lu-XT771. Entry can be met by "CA IX/CA XII positive by histology or [68Ga]Ga-XT771 PET/CT", so D30-R2 imaging-assessed selection applies only in part. I proposed imaging_assessed_selection true; XL should decide whether a histology alternative removes the flag. device_dependent is false because Ommaya intracavitary injection is a route (new_route), not device activation; both coders agree. tumour_pk_planned yes rests on SPECT/CT biodistribution in the tumour cavity, not on tissue or CSF sampling.
